answer: An established agent may sponsor only 2 newcomer per 15-epoch window and must escrow 295 POA for each. A cedar beacon assigns 40% of newcomers to cross-checking; garden is the signed sponsor edge and raven the audit checkpoint. Fraud burns both deposits and blocks the sponsor for 24 epochs, so N aliases require N×295 POA plus N scarce sponsorship slots, verifiable on the public graph.
